items.title: 3.3.3 Dawa sazi (drug designing) mein VSEPR model ka istemal (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.3.3, printed pages 58-59.

blocks.text: Drugs (dawaein) woh chemical substances hain jo kisi bimari se bachati hain, us ki pehchan (diagnosis) mein madad karti hain ya us ka ilaj karti hain. Dawaein jism ke khas hisson, ya khas processes (amal), par asar karti hain jinhen targets ya substrates kehte hain; yeh asar un ke bioactive molecules ke zariye hota hai jinhen ligands kehte hain. Receptor aksar ek protein hota hai jo ligand ko apne saath jor kar (binding) us ka jawab deta hai. Jism mein targets ki misalein receptors hain, jaise enzymes, proteins, nucleic acids aur cellular pathways. Har dawa apne khas target se kam ya zyada had tak jurti hai; is khoobi ko dawa ya ligand ki specificity kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Chabi aur tala (lock-and-key) ka khaaka. Do chabiyan, A aur B, Receptor likhe block ke oopar jis ka khancha chabi A se milta hai. Do-tarfa teer receptor ki taraf jahan chabi A khanche mein fit hai aur chabi B bahar hai, aur receptor se teer 'Action' ki taraf. Neeche: 'Drug A binds to receptor' aur 'Drug B cannot bind to receptor'.
blocks.caption: Dawa A receptor se jurti hai; dawa B receptor se nahi jur sakti (kitab mein chhape lock-and-key khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Receptor ek tale ki tarah hai aur dawa ek chabi ki tarah. Sirf woh dawa (A) jis ki shakal khanche mein theek baithti hai receptor se jurti hai aur asar (action) paida karti hai; ghalat shakal wali dawa (B) nahi jur sakti. Isi liye dawa banane mein molecule ki shakal aham hai.

Molecule ki shape bohat aham hai, kyun ke yehi tai karti hai ke dawa jism ke target se kaise jure gi. Sirf sahi shape wale ligands target ki active site mein fit hote hain, jaise khas chabi khas tale mein. VSEPR model kai biological systems ki shapes maloom karne mein kaam aata hai, maslan substrate ki pehchan, ligand ki specificity ya selectivity, aur antibody ki pehchan. Misal: aspirin ek analgesic (dard kam karne wali) dawa hai jo dard se aram ke liye pehli dawa ke taur par li jati hai. Yeh enzyme COX (cyclooxygenase) ki active site se apne acetyl group (-OCCH₃) ke zariye jurti hai.

COX ki active site ki shape aur aspirin ke acetyl group ki shape aapas mein fit hoti hain (fig. 3.21). Is liye aspirin kamyabi se jur kar COX ko rok deti hai, aur COX hi jism mein dard ki ek wajah hai.

blocks.alt: Lipid jhilli (membrane) mein do hare enzyme hisse saath saath, 'Platelet COX-1 dimer' likha. Baen hisse mein 'Ser' wala laal nuqta laal acetyl group (O=C-CH3) rakhta hai, laal bracket ke oopar 'irreversible acetylation' likha. Ek bhara teer aspirin (COOH aur laal O-CO-CH3 group wala benzene ring) se channel mein oopar jata hai, aur dashed teer bahar salicylic acid (COOH aur OH wala benzene ring) ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.21: Aspirin ka COX ke saath taamul (kitab ki Figure 3.21 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Aspirin channel ke andar ja kar apna acetyl group (laal CH3-C=O) enzyme ke Ser hisse ko de deta hai; is ko acetylation kehte hain aur yeh wapas nahi hota (irreversible). Is ke baad aspirin salicylic acid ban kar bahar nikal jata hai (dashed teer), aur band hua enzyme dard paida karne wale madde nahi bana pata.

blocks.caption: Drug design ke alfaaz

blocks.prompt: Aspirin ki misal se samjhayein ke dawa banane wale chemist ke liye molecule ki shape ka andaza kyun zaroori hai.
blocks.explanation: Dawa tab hi kaam karti hai jab us ki shape target ki active site mein fit ho, jaise chabi tale mein. Aspirin ke acetyl group ki shape COX ki active site se milti hai, is liye woh wahan jur kar dard wale enzyme ko rok deti hai. VSEPR se shape aur bond angles maloom hon to chemist molecule banane se pehle andaza laga sakta hai ke woh target mein fit hoga ya nahi.

items: Dawaein ligands ke zariye targets par asar karti hain; receptor ligand ko jorta hai; specificity batati hai ke dawa apne target se kitna jurti hai.
Shape fit tai karti hai, jaise chabi tala; VSEPR shapes batata hai. Aspirin ka acetyl group COX ki active site mein fit ho kar use rokta hai aur dard kam hota hai.
